categories.label: Signature object
categories.note: The one thing that belongs to them

items.t: A battered notebook, always within reach.
A mug that is clearly theirs.
A toolbag, set down but close.
A musical instrument, carried rather than played.
A bundle of keys on a long lanyard.
A plant in a pot, carried like a pet.
An old radio, repaired more than once.
